name: ambiguous_but_reasonable
description: Reasonable reading of an ambiguous period; weak low note only.

execution.sql:
SELECT e.full_name, c.currency_code, SUM(c.amount) AS total_spend
FROM card_transactions AS c
JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE c.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY e.full_name, c.currency_code
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10

findings.description: interprets 'recently' as the last three months
